title: Agents SDK logs 'OPENAI_API_KEY is not set, skipping trace export' when using another model provider
symptoms: OPENAI_API_KEY is not set, skipping trace export
Agent runs succeed but no traces appear in the OpenAI dashboard
cause: Tracing is on by default and exports to OpenAI with an OpenAI key, even when the agent runs on a non-OpenAI model through a custom client. Tracing is also unavailable to organizations under Zero Data Retention.
fix: Disable tracing, or give the exporter its own OpenAI key.
apply:
from agents import set_tracing_disabled, set_tracing_export_api_key
set_tracing_disabled(True)
# or keep tracing: set_tracing_export_api_key(os.environ["OPENAI_TRACING_KEY"])
affected: openai-agents-python 0.x with non-OpenAI providers or ZDR organizations, checked October 2026
